not_official: LinkedIn publishes no official OpenAPI definition for these products. drafts/linkedin/definition.openapi.json was written by hand from the pages below; only URLs, hashes of the bytes fetched and the facts used are recorded here, not copies of the documentation.

documentation.used_for: OpenID Connect discovery: authorization/token endpoints, GET https://api.linkedin.com/v2/userinfo and its claims; scopes openid profile email
Share on LinkedIn self-serve product; w_member_social creates posts on behalf of the authenticated member

POST /rest/posts body (author, commentary, visibility, distribution, lifecycleState, isReshareDisabledByAuthor), 201 with x-restli-id, DELETE /rest/posts/{encoded URN} 204; LinkedIn-Version and X-Restli-Protocol-Version headers; organization posting requires Community Management roles
3-legged authorization code flow; client_id/client_secret sent in the form body; 60-day access tokens
latest version header 202610; version sunset schedule
daily application/member rate limits shown in the developer portal
programmatic refresh tokens only for approved Marketing Developer Platform partners
